Emma, Norman and Ray are the brightest kids at the Grace Field House orphanage. And under the care of the woman they refer to as “Mom,” all the kids have enjoyed a comfortable life. Good food, clean clothes and the perfect environment to learn—what more could an orphan ask for? One day, though, Emma and Norman uncover the dark truth of the outside world they are forbidden from seeing.
(Source: VIZ Media)

Japan’s desire for World Cup glory leads the Japanese Football Association to launch a new rigorous training program to find the national team’s next striker. Three hundred high school players are pitted against each other for the position, but only one will come out on top. Who among them will be the striker to usher in a new era of Japanese soccer?
(Source: Crunchyroll)
Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Supernatural

In Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Mugen Train Arc, Tanjiro Kamado and his fellow Demon Slayer members embark on a mission aboard the Infinity Train. Their new mission is to investigate a series of mysterious disappearances, carried out by a demon that has been terrorizing passengers and killing the demon slayers who oppose it. Note: The first episode is entirely anime original. Episodes 2-7 are a re-edited version of the movie featuring new scenes and music.
Action, Comedy, Slice of Life, Supernatural

Everyone has a part of themselves they cannot show to anyone else.
At a time when all nations of the world were involved in a fierce war of information happening behind closed doors, Ostania and Westalis had been in a state of cold war against one another for decades. The Westalis Intelligence Services' Eastern-Focused Division (WISE) sends their most talented spy, "Twilight," on a top-secret mission to investigate the movements of Donovan Desmond, the chairman of Ostania's National Unity Party, who is threatening peace efforts between the two nations.
This mission is known as "Operation Strix." It consists of "putting together a family in one week in order to infiltrate social gatherings organized by the elite school that Desmond's son attends." "Twilight" takes on the identity of psychiatrist Loid Forger and starts looking for family members. But Anya, the daughter he adopts, turns out to have the ability to read people's minds, while his wife, Yor, is an assassin! With it being in each of their own interests to keep these facts hidden, they start living together while concealing their true identities from one another. World peace is now in the hands of this brand-new family as they embark on an adventure full of surprises.
(Source: Crunchyroll)
Tensei Majutsushi no Isekai Seikatsu: Gensaku Chishiki de Sekai Saikyou

"The Adventure of Allen The Hero," is the novel written by our protagonist. Overwhelmingly popular and widely read, everyone was eagerly awaiting the conclusion of the story. Despite being told he doesn't have much time left to live, he put his life on the line to complete the series. Unfortunately, his lifespan ran out just as he finished writing the final volume— but…

"Why did I become such a nobody character?"
He unexpectedly transmigrated into the very novel he wrote. And he was put into the body of Will, an underdog mob character from the early part of the novel. The eldest son of a noble family soon to fall into ruin, he's a character with no talent in magic, with a miserable future ahead of him. It was the worst starting point, but that's no problem for him, the author. As the writer of the original work, he knows all when the quests and events occur, where the strongest magical items are hidden, all the characteristics and weaknesses of the monsters, and the secrets of the world itself.

In order to change his doomed fate, Will will use his knowledge of the original story and aim to become the strongest in the world. "I’ll change the future. That’s the reason why I have all this knowledge." Using his story knowledge as a cheat to change the fate of a mob character that will even have the hero in awe, he’ll gain unparalleled power in this world—!

(Source: Hyke Comic, translated)

Not all job classes are created equal! Marnac was pulled into a game while trying to play as one of its worst job classes, cleric of decay. Now he’s the only cleric of the Order of Decay, serving a goddess who’s been reduced to an animated hand that repeats the word “MURDER!” Will the Order’s last cleric become powerful enough before the prophecy of “the end” comes true?
(Source: WEBTOON)
